sys_scope.description: Duplicate record detection and safe merge. Scans configurable tables, scores candidate duplicates with fuzzy matching, and merges them safely with full audit and rollback.
sys_scope.name: DedupeGuard

sys_user_role.name: x_snc_ddg.admin
sys_user_role.description: DedupeGuard administrator — configure scans, execute merges, roll back.

sys_user_role.name: x_snc_ddg.user
sys_user_role.description: DedupeGuard user — read duplicate candidates and merge audit.

sys_property.description: Comma-separated list of tables to scan for duplicates.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.scan.tables

sys_property.description: Maximum records collected per table scan.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.scan.limit

sys_property.description: Confidence (0-100) at or above which a pair is auto-queued for merge.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.threshold.auto_merge

sys_property.description: Confidence (0-100) at or above which a pair is surfaced for review.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.threshold.review

sys_property.description: Weight of the primary match field.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.weight.primary

sys_property.description: Weight of the secondary match field.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.weight.secondary

sys_property.description: Weight of the tertiary match field.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.weight.tertiary

sys_property.description: Weight of the quaternary match field.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.weight.quaternary

sys_property.description: Comma-separated weight list applied to match fields in order.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.weight.list

sys_property.description: Maximum child records re-pointed per reference field.
sys_property.name: x_snc_ddg.merge.max_repoint

sys_script_include.name: DedupeGuardEngine

sys_script_include.description: Safe merge engine with reference re-pointing, audit, and rollback.
sys_script_include.name: DedupeGuardMerge

sys_ws_operation.name: GET /candidates
POST /execute
